annotations.title: Save lead consent and follow-up settings

description:
[writes · `ads:manage` scope] Saves the brand's lead consent: consentText, consentVersion (a new version is required when the wording changes), consentTitle, consentCheckboxLabel, and the switches enabled (store leads) and followUpEnabled (email leads who ticked consent; needs enabled). Every field left out keeps its saved value, then the default (v1 wording). Required before ads_lead_form_consent_copy. Pass agentName and reason. Confirm with the user before turning followUpEnabled on: it emails real leads.
(Wraps POST /api/v2/ads/lead-forms/consent.)

agentName.description: Which agent is acting. Shown to the owner in Ads > Agent activity.

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

consentVersion.description: 1-40 characters; change it whenever the wording changes.

reason.description: Why the agent is doing this. Shown to the owner and kept in the audit trail.

name: ads_lead_form_consent_set
